_about: Livy in English: the Bohn translation, complete across four Gutenberg texts (D. Spillan, Cyrus Edmonds, W. A. McDevitte; Books I-VIII, IX-XXVI, XXVII-XXXVI, XXXVII to the end with the Epitomes and fragments). Also Church and Brodribb's Books I-III (ed. Osborne). Latin-facing Loebs of 1930 or earlier added 2026-10-02 as raw IA OCR (translator per row); the scan's printing was checked for a post-1930 revision notice where its title verso survives.

livy-bohn-1-8: The History of Rome, Books I-VIII
livy-bohn-9-26: The History of Rome, Books IX-XXVI
tr. D. Spillan and Cyrus Edmonds (Bohn)
livy-bohn-27-36: The History of Rome, Books XXVII-XXXVI
livy-bohn-37-end: The History of Rome, Books XXXVII to the end, with the Epitomes and Fragments
livy-church-brodribb-1-3: tr. A. J. Church and W. J. Brodribb, ed. Duffield Osborne

_excluded.B. O. Foster, Loeb (1919-): vols. 1, 4, 5 held (IA); vol. 2 (1922) only as a 1939 revised printing, refused; vol. 3 (1924) no scan found; vols. 6- after 1930
